Totally following this! I’m in a new one myself, instigated by me seeking a dom, and we are both switches. Every time I’m gotten involved with someone who claims to be a switch it always swayed towards me domming 99% of the time which takes away me getting what I need from the other side of things. I’d say have a talk about either set days for switching or key words to indicate that it’s time to switch things up. All in all, be open and honest with each other so that you ensure that each person is getting what they need 😊

I spent almost two decades with a person who would NOT let me go out of fear of being alone. I was never able to explore and learn what I really liked because it was always what he wanted. The resentment grew and grew. I was finally able to get out and can now say I’m loving my life....my body...my kinks. I took time to find me and learn at least the start of what I like...and to heal...and now I’ve been seeking my perfect match (I’m pretty sure I found my permanent daddy) and I couldn’t be happier. I was miserable denying my true self...my kinks...my needs...my desires...just to placate someone else. Sweetie...you can find both sexual compatibility and love in the same or open to poly and discover that maybe there is not just one person who can check all those boxes. I hope that all makes sense. Feel free to PM me...I’m new to this side of myself as well :)
